tools.description: Execute exactly one approved official HLP preview after a later explicit chat confirmation. Position and funding requests open Wallet Review directly and never use this tool. The preview is consumed before dispatch and cannot be retried.
tools.name: holon_perpdex_execute

tools.description: Build one internal live preview and immediately open Wallet Review to deposit the user's exact native-USDC amount to the active Hyperliquid trading account on Arbitrum. This never signs, submits, or opens a trade.
tools.name: holon_perpdex_fund_prepare

tools.description: Read current public BTC, ETH, and SOL Hyperliquid market state.
tools.name: holon_perpdex_markets

tools.description: Read the active Wallet account's public Hyperliquid positions, orders, collateral, and official HLP state.
tools.name: holon_perpdex_portfolio

tools.description: Build a protected BTC, ETH or SOL position or official HLP request. For OPEN_POSITION pass user margin as amount_usdc or final position size as notional_usdc; if both are supplied they must exactly match leverage. Complete position requests open Wallet Review directly. HLP returns a preview for later explicit chat confirmation. This never signs or submits.
tools.name: holon_perpdex_prepare

amount_mode.description: FULL or ALL closes a complete position; PERCENT closes a stated percent; EXACT or ALL applies to HLP withdrawal.

amount_usdc.description: For OPEN_POSITION this is user margin before leverage. For HLP this is the exact deposit or withdrawal amount.

leverage.description: Integer position leverage. Required only for OPEN_POSITION.

margin_mode.description: OPEN_POSITION margin mode. Omit to use ISOLATED.

market.description: Position market. Required for OPEN_POSITION and CLOSE_POSITION.

notional_usdc.description: Final OPEN_POSITION size including leverage. Do not also send amount_usdc unless both values exactly match leverage.

percent.description: Decimal percent greater than zero and below 100 for a PERCENT position close.

side.description: Position direction. Required only for OPEN_POSITION.
